mapper.select: select DATE_FORMAT(l.claim_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as claimAt, c.gift_code as giftCode, c.kol_message as kolMessage, c.point_amount as pointAmount, c.reward_type as rewardType, c.vip_days as vipDays from blv_redeem_logs l inner join blv_redeem_codes c on l.code_id = c.id where l.brand_id = #{brandId} order by l.claim_at desc
